metadata.title: Experimental Thermal Decomposition Temperature (T_dec) and Molecular Mechanism Database for Semiconductor Precursors
metadata.description: Literature-verified decomposition temperatures, thermal measurement conditions (DSC/TGA/NMR/QMS/FT-IR/flow-pyrolysis/ALD window), activation energies, and molecular-level decomposition mechanisms for 32 precursors in the SAPIS database.
metadata.measurement_caveat: Measured T_dec varies strongly by analytical modality: hermetically sealed-pan DSC isolates condensed-phase unimolecular thermolysis from evaporation, open-pan TGA convolves volatilization with decomposition, and ALD/CVD reactor onset reflects heterogeneous surface-catalyzed breakdown (sensitive to S/V ratio and co-reactants). Always interpret T_dec together with its recorded measurement_conditions.

PREC_SI_01.name: DIPAS
PREC_SI_01.t_dec_metric: Loss of self-limiting ALD behavior / onset of parasitic thermal decomposition

measurement_conditions.technique: Thermal ALD GPC-vs-temperature profiling & DFT thermochemistry
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Low-pressure ALD reactor (N2/Ar purge, O3 co-reactant window)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Heated Si/SiO2 wafer surface (heterogeneous wall-assisted regime)

activation_energy.method: Not directly measured via isothermal pyrolysis in open literature

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Si-N cleavage / intramolecular beta-H transfer from isopropyl groups yielding propene and reactive silylene/silanimine intermediates
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Initial Si-H / Si-N activation and isopropyl beta-H elimination at >250 °C
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: C/N-incorporated SiOxNy above 300 °C without sufficient oxidizer

references.citation: Ceram. Int. 2017, 43, 2106 (Low-temperature SiO2 ALD using DIPAS and O3)
RSC Adv. 2020, 10, 12832 (First-principles study of aminosilane surface reactions)

PREC_SI_02.name: BTBAS
PREC_SI_02.t_dec_metric: Onset of non-self-limiting thermal CVD decomposition & surface ligand elimination

measurement_conditions.technique: Thermal/PE-ALD temperature-window profiling, surface FT-IR & CCSD(T)/DFT modeling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Low-pressure ALD/CVD reactor (inert Ar/N2 carrier)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Heated Si / SiNx / SiO2 substrate
measurement_conditions.phase_regime: Surface-bound ligand elimination & gas-phase pyrolysis onset

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Concerted Si-N cleavage and tert-butyl beta-H elimination releasing isobutene and silanimine/silylene intermediates
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Intramolecular H-transfer / tert-butyl C-N scission of surface -NHtBu species (330–350 °C)
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: Amorphous SiNxCy / SiO2 (with O3/plasma)

references.citation: Knoops et al., Chem. Mater. 2015, 27, 5058 (ALD of SiNx from BTBAS)
J. Phys. Chem. A 2021, 125, 8620 (CCSD(T)/DFT aminosilane decomposition kinetics)

PREC_SI_03.name: 3DMAS
PREC_SI_03.t_dec_metric: Upper thermal stability limit in 3D high-aspect-ratio ALD; onset of uncontrolled CVD growth

measurement_conditions.technique: High-temperature ALD GPC/step-coverage profiling & DFT BDE/elimination modeling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Low-pressure ALD reactor (N2/Ar)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: 3D high-aspect-ratio Si trench substrate

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Weakest-link Si-H homolysis and concerted methyl-H transfer yielding silanimine (Si=N) and CH4/imine byproducts
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Initial Si-H cleavage or intramolecular H-transfer across Si-N-CH3
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: C/N-rich SiOxNy above 650–700 °C

references.citation: Ceram. Int. 2024, 50 (3DMAS high-temperature ALD stability up to 700 °C)
J. Phys. Chem. A 2021, 125 (Aminosilane BDE and concerted elimination pathways)

PREC_SI_04.name: 4DMAS
PREC_SI_04.t_dec_display: 250–300 °C (onset of surface/vapor thermolysis above boiling point 196 °C)

measurement_conditions.technique: TGA & gas-phase aminosilane thermolysis / DFT modeling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/Ar carrier gas (1 atm TGA / low-pressure CVD)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Open Al/Pt TGA pan (evaporates cleanly <200 °C); heated reactor surface for pyrolysis

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Si-N and N-CH3 cleavage via intramolecular H-transfer yielding HNMe2, CH4, and reactive silanimine (Si=N) / methyleneimine intermediates
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: H-transfer from N-methyl to adjacent amido N (no beta-H on methyl)
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: Si3N4 / SiCN network at elevated temperature

references.citation: J. Phys. Chem. A 2021, 125 (Aminosilane thermal decomposition pathways)

PREC_SI_05.name: TSA
PREC_SI_05.t_dec_display: 300–500 °C (thermal CVD/ALD decomposition range; planar p_pi-d_pi stabilized)
PREC_SI_05.t_dec_metric: Thermal decomposition onset in CVD/ALD reactors

measurement_conditions.technique: Thermal CVD/ALD pyrolysis & DFT reaction-barrier analysis
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Low-pressure CVD/ALD reactor (inert N2/Ar or NH3)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Heated Si / Si3N4 wafer surface

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Si-H cleavage and 1,2-H shift releasing silylene (:SiH2) and SiH4, forming lower silylamines and polysilazane networks
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Si-H / Si-N bond activation generating :SiH2 or SiH3. radicals
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: Carbon-free dense Si3N4 network

references.citation: Beagley & Conrad, Trans. Faraday Soc. 1970, 66, 2740 (Planar structure & p_pi-d_pi bonding of TSA)

measurement_conditions.technique: Static/flow gas-phase pyrolysis with I2 scavenging & RRKM/ab initio kinetics
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Low-to-moderate pressure gas phase (Torr to 1 atm, pressure-dependent RRKM falloff)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Passivated quartz/glass pyrolysis vessel (homogeneous gas-phase isolated)

activation_energy.ea_kcal_mol: 35–45 (Swihart & Carr ab initio / Doncaster & Walsh exp.)

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Concerted 1,2-Cl shift across the weak Si-Si bond yielding SiCl4 and reactive singlet dichlorosilylene (:SiCl2)
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Concerted Cl-migration / Si-Si bond cleavage transition state (not homolytic Si-Cl scission)
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: Amorphous Si / polychlorosilane oligomers on heated surfaces

references.citation: Doncaster & Walsh, J. Chem. Soc., Faraday Trans. 1 1980, 76, 272 (Experimental HCDS pyrolysis kinetics)
Swihart & Carr, J. Phys. Chem. A 1997, 101, 7434 (Ab initio chlorinated disilane thermochemistry)

PREC_SI_07.name: TEOS
PREC_SI_07.t_dec_metric: Flow-reactor pyrolysis onset (inert atmosphere without O3)

measurement_conditions.technique: Tubular flow-reactor pyrolysis with GC-MS/FT-IR & TST kinetic modeling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/He carrier (1 atm or LPCVD 0.1–10 Torr); O3 drastically lowers Ea to ~49 kJ/mol
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Quartz tube / SiO2 wall
measurement_conditions.phase_regime: Homogeneous gas-phase molecular elimination (with radical channel at >700 °C)

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Stepwise intramolecular 4-center/6-center beta-H elimination yielding ethylene and silanol intermediates, followed by condensation
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: First concerted 4-center beta-H transfer from ethoxy -CH3 to oxygen (Ea ~200–209 kJ/mol)
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: Amorphous SiO2 (with minor carbon at >700 °C under inert pyrolysis)

references.citation: Pol et al., J. Mater. Chem. 2004, 14, 966 (Thermal decomposition of TEOS)

PREC_HK_01.name: TEMAH
PREC_HK_01.t_dec_metric: In-situ ATR-FTIR / gas-phase FT-IR & TGA/DSC decomposition onset

measurement_conditions.technique: In-situ ATR-FTIR / gas-phase FT-IR, TGA/DSC & DFT modeling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/Ar or UHV/low-pressure ALD chamber
measurement_conditions.container_surface: H-Si(100) / SiO2 surface (FT-IR); Al/Pt pan (TGA/DSC)

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Intramolecular beta-hydride elimination from ethyl groups of -N(Me)(Et) ligands forming volatile imines and Hf-H intermediates
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Beta-H transfer from ethyl -CH2-/-CH3 to Hf/N center releasing imine
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: C/N-contaminated HfOxNy / HfCxNy upon pure thermolysis

references.citation: Hausmann et al., Chem. Mater. 2002, 14, 4350 (ALD of HfO2/ZrO2 from alkylamides)
Chem. Mater. 2014, 26 (Mechanisms of metal alkylamide decomposition)

measurement_conditions.technique: TGA/DSC, in-situ FT-IR & ALD GPC-temperature profiling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/Ar (TGA/DSC); low-pressure ALD reactor
measurement_conditions.container_surface: TGA/DSC pan; H-Si(100) / oxide substrate

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: No ethyl beta-H; proceeds via intramolecular alpha-H abstraction / metallaziridine formation and dimethylamine elimination
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Intramolecular C-H activation of methyl group to form cyclic Hf-CH2-NMe intermediate
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: HfNxCy (carbon/nitrogen residue without H2O/O3)

references.citation: Hausmann et al., Chem. Mater. 2002, 14, 4350 (Group-4 metal alkylamide ALD)
Chem. Mater. 2014, 26 (Mechanisms of metal alkylamide decomposition)

PREC_HK_03.name: Hf(OtBu)4
PREC_HK_03.t_dec_metric: TGA/DSC & real-time FT-IR substrate decomposition onset

measurement_conditions.technique: TGA/DSC, vapor-pressure calorimetry & real-time FT-IR
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/Ar or vacuum (~1 Torr at 65 °C, 0.1 Torr at 100 °C)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Open pan (TGA evaporation <150 °C); heated Si/oxide wafer (FT-IR)

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Intramolecular beta-H elimination from tert-butoxide ligands releasing isobutene and forming Hf-OH / HfO2 networks
molecular_mechanism.reaction_equation: Hf(OtBu)4 -> Hf(OH)(OtBu)3 + i-C4H8 -> HfO2 + 4 i-C4H8 + 2 H2O (or tBuOH)
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Concerted 4-center beta-H transfer from tert-butyl methyl to alkoxide oxygen
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: HfO2 (with 1–3 at.% C impurity without oxidizer)

references.citation: Fulem & Ruzicka, Fluid Phase Equilib. 2011, 311, 25 (Thermophysics of Hf(OtBu)4)
Klein et al., J. Vac. Sci. Technol. A 2007, 25 (Real-time FT-IR of HTB decomposition)

PREC_HK_04.name: TEMAZ
PREC_HK_04.t_dec_metric: TGA/DSC & ALD upper thermal window onset

measurement_conditions.technique: TGA/DSC, in-situ FT-IR & ALD temperature-window profiling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/Ar (TGA/DSC); low-pressure ALD chamber
measurement_conditions.container_surface: TGA pan / heated Si or ZrO2 substrate

activation_energy.method: Comparative Group-4 alkylamide thermal stability study

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Intramolecular beta-hydride elimination from ethyl groups yielding N-methylethanimine and ethylmethylamine
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Beta-H transfer from ethyl ligand to Zr/N center (lower stability than Hf analog TEMAH)
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: C/N-containing ZrOxNy / ZrCxNy

references.citation: Hausmann et al., Chem. Mater. 2002, 14, 4350 (ALD of ZrO2/HfO2 from alkylamides)
Chem. Mater. 2014, 26 (Mechanisms of metal alkylamide decomposition)

PREC_HK_05.name: TDMAZ
PREC_HK_05.t_dec_metric: Tensimetry, mass spectrometry & heated-surface vapor decomposition onset

measurement_conditions.technique: Static tensimetry, mass spectrometry (MS) & TGA/DSC
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Vacuum / inert vapor phase (tensimetry & MS)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Glass/quartz tensimetry membrane & heated substrate

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Intramolecular alpha-H abstraction / metallacycle formation and reductive elimination (lacks ethyl beta-H)
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Methyl C-H activation / intramolecular H-transfer to adjacent -NMe2
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: ZrNxCy residue

references.citation: Vikulova et al., Russ. Chem. Bull. 2025 (Tensimetry & MS thermal behavior of TDMAZ)
Hausmann et al., Chem. Mater. 2002, 14, 4350

PREC_HK_07.name: Cp(NMe2)3Zr
PREC_HK_07.t_dec_metric: In-situ gas-phase FT-IR (C=N growth / CH3 decay) & QMS byproduct onset

measurement_conditions.technique: In-situ gas-phase FT-IR + QMS thermal stressing system & TGA/DSC
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert Ar/N2 carrier gas at low pressure (evaporator 100–170 °C)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Heated stainless-steel / optical gas cell

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Selective degradation of -NMe2 ligands (Cp ring remains intact longer) via H-transfer and rearrangement to N-ethylmethanimine and NMe3
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Initial Zr-NMe2 / methyl C-H activation (CH3 IR band decays while -CH2- and C=N bands grow >250 °C)
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: C/N-containing ZrOxNy if overheated above 310 °C

references.citation: An et al., Nanoscale Res. Lett. 2020, 15, 165 (In-situ FT-IR & QMS monitoring of CpZr(NMe2)3)

PREC_TI_01.name: TDMAT
PREC_TI_01.t_dec_metric: Liquid-phase 1H NMR & DSC onset; in-situ QMS dual-regime pyrolysis

measurement_conditions.technique: Liquid-phase 1H NMR, DSC & in-situ Molecular Beam QMS
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Sealed inert tube (NMR/DSC); low-pressure CVD reactor (QMS)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Sealed glass NMR tube / DSC pan; reactor walls (strong S/V effect < 257 °C)

activation_energy.method: In-situ Molecular Beam QMS Arrhenius kinetics

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Intramolecular proton transfer from methyl to adjacent -NMe2 eliminating HNMe2 and forming metallaziridine / imine intermediates
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Surface-catalyzed adsorption/H-transfer (<530 K, Ea=16 kJ/mol) switching to unimolecular gas-phase cleavage (>530 K, Ea=166 kJ/mol)
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: Carbon-rich TiNxCy without NH3 co-reactant

references.citation: Yun, Park, Rhee, J. Electrochem. Soc. 1999, 146, 1804 (Liquid NMR & DSC of TDMAT vs TDEAT)
Chem. Mater. 2002 (Ti(NMe2)4 pyrolysis kinetics)

measurement_conditions.technique: TGA/DSC, flow-reactor pyrolysis & first-principles TST / ReaxFF-MD
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/Ar or vacuum (trace H2O shifts onset down to ~100 °C via hydrolysis)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Al/Pt TGA pan; quartz/metal CVD wall

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Stepwise 4-membered cyclic beta-H elimination of propene (isopropanol analogy); competing C-C homolysis (CH3. loss) at high T
molecular_mechanism.reaction_equation: Ti(OiPr)4 -> Ti(OH)(OiPr)3 + C3H6 -> TiO2 + 4 C3H6 + 2 H2O (or 2 iPrOH + 2 C3H6)
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: First concerted 4-center beta-H transfer from isopropoxide -CH3 to alkoxide oxygen
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: Amorphous/anatase TiO2

references.citation: Buerger et al., J. Phys. Chem. A 2015, 119, 8376 (First-principles thermochemistry of TTIP decomposition)
Fazlioglu Yalcin et al., arXiv:2212.11871 (ReaxFF-MD atomic-scale TTIP decomposition)

PREC_TI_03.name: CpTi(NMe2)3
PREC_TI_03.t_dec_metric: TGA/DSC delivery stability & thermal ALD upper window

measurement_conditions.technique: TGA/DSC & ALD temperature-window profiling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/Ar (TGA/DSC); low-pressure ALD chamber
measurement_conditions.container_surface: TGA pan / heated Si or TiO2 substrate

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Selective cleavage of weaker Ti-NMe2 bonds (Cp ring stabilizes metal center relative to TDMAT) via intramolecular H-transfer
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Ti-NMe2 bond activation / methyl H-transfer (~80 °C more stable than homoleptic TDMAT)
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: TiNxCy / TiO2 (with O3/plasma)

references.citation: Chem. Mater. 2002 (Baseline Ti-amide thermal decomposition)

PREC_AL_01.name: TMA
PREC_AL_01.t_dec_metric: DSC exothermic onset & gas-phase/flash pyrolysis MS

measurement_conditions.technique: Sealed-pan DSC, flash pyrolysis photoion spectroscopy & surface TPD
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Sealed inert pan (DSC); vacuum / inert carrier (pyrolysis)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Sealed stainless-steel/Al pan (DSC); Si/GaAs/Al2O3 reactor walls

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Dimer dissociation Al2Me6 -> 2 AlMe3 followed by homolytic Al-C bond scission generating CH3. radicals and H-abstraction to CH4
molecular_mechanism.reaction_equation: Al(CH3)3 -> Al(CH3)2. + CH3. ; CH3. + Al(CH3)3 -> CH4 + Al(CH2)(CH3)2.
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Homolytic first Al-C bond scission (gas phase) or surface-assisted CH4 elimination
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: Al4C3 / carbon-contaminated Al without H2O/O3

references.citation: Chem. Eur. J. 2017, 23 (Al-Me bond degradation modeling)
Chem. Phys. Lett. 2016, 665, 113 (Flash pyrolysis methyl radical spectroscopy)

PREC_AL_02.name: DMAH
PREC_AL_02.t_dec_display: 250–400 °C (MOCVD/gas-phase decomposition range; lower than TMA C-free Al deposition)

measurement_conditions.technique: Gas-phase pyrolysis mass spectrometry & ab initio (MP2/DFT) pathway mapping
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Low-pressure H2/Ar carrier gas (oligomeric dimer/trimer vapor equilibrium)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Heated Si / metallic Al growth surface

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Ring-opening of DMAH dimer/trimer followed by concerted hydride-methyl elimination releasing CH4 and H2 (suppressing carbon uptake)
molecular_mechanism.reaction_equation: [AlH(CH3)2]2/3 -> AlH(CH3)2 -> Al(s) + 2 CH4 + 1/2 H2 (or AlMe3 + AlH3 disproportionation)
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Oligomer dissociation and concerted Al-H / Al-CH3 elimination
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: High-purity metallic Al (significantly lower C than TMA)

references.citation: Willis & Jensen, J. Phys. Chem. A 2000, 104, 7881 (Gas-phase reaction pathways of DMAH)
Matsumiya & Nakajima, J. Cryst. Growth 1997, 181, 437 (Temperature dependence of DMAH decomposition)

PREC_MET_01.name: BTBMW
PREC_MET_01.t_dec_metric: Sealed-pan DSC exothermic onset & ALD window limit

measurement_conditions.technique: Hermetically sealed-pan DSC, open-pan TGA & ALD window profiling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/Ar (1 atm TGA; autogenous sealed Al pan DSC)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Hermetically sealed Al pan (DSC); open Pt pan (TGA, 1 Torr ~80 °C)

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Intramolecular gamma-H activation of tert-butylimido (=NtBu) ligands eliminating isobutene, concurrent with dimethylamine loss
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: 4-/6-center gamma-H transfer from tert-butyl to imido nitrogen releasing isobutene
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: WNxCy / W2N / WOx (with oxidizer)

references.citation: J. Vac. Sci. Technol. A 2017, 35, 01B117 (ALD/CVD using BTBMW/BTBMMo)
Land, Bacic, Robertson, Barry, Inorg. Chem. 2022, 61, 4980 (Group-6 bis-imide thermolysis)

PREC_MET_02.name: BTBMMo
PREC_MET_02.t_dec_display: 250–300 °C (DSC/TGA & ALD upper onset; 1 Torr vapor pressure at 79 °C)
PREC_MET_02.t_dec_metric: Hermetically sealed-pan DSC onset (5% exothermic deviation, Barry protocol) & ALD window

measurement_conditions.technique: Hermetically sealed-pan DSC (Barry protocol), TGA & DFT transition-state modeling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Autogenous inert N2 inside hermetically sealed Al pan (suppresses evaporation)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Hermetically sealed Al DSC pan; open Pt TGA pan

activation_energy.method: Sealed-pan DSC & DFT decomposition pathway analysis (Barry group)

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Intramolecular gamma-H activation of tert-butylimido (=NtBu) ligands releasing isobutene via cyclic transition state, followed by -NMe2 elimination
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Gamma-H abstraction from tert-butyl group yielding isobutene and Mo=NH intermediate
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: MoNxCy / MoO3 / MoS2 (with H2S)

references.citation: Land, Bacic, Robertson, Barry, Inorg. Chem. 2022, 61, 4980 (Sealed-pan DSC & pathways of Mo(VI) bis-imides)
Land, Bacic, Robertson, Barry, Inorg. Chem. 2022, 61, 16607 (Origin of decomposition in Mo precursors)

PREC_MET_03.name: Ru(EtCp)2
PREC_MET_03.t_dec_display: 270–300 °C (inert pyrolysis onset; broad DSC endotherm 240–290 °C; 0% TGA residue)
PREC_MET_03.t_dec_metric: TGA/DSC & Arrhenius CVD growth-rate kinetics (inert vs O2)

measurement_conditions.technique: TGA, DSC & MOCVD Arrhenius kinetics (inert Ar/N2 vs O2 co-flow)
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert Ar/N2 (pure pyrolysis) vs O2-assisted (oxidative pyrolysis lowers Ea ~4x)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Open TGA pan (0% solid residue, clean evaporation); heated SiO2/TiN wafer
measurement_conditions.phase_regime: Vapor pyrolysis vs surface oxygen-assisted combustion

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Inert: Ru-Cp ring cleavage & ethyl side-chain beta-H/radical stripping. Oxidative (O2): surface-adsorbed O combusts EtCp ligands to CO2 + H2O
molecular_mechanism.reaction_equation: Inert: Ru(EtCp)2 -> Ru(0) + hydrocarbons (C2H4, CpH) | O2: Ru(EtCp)2 + O2 -> Ru/RuO2 + CO2 + H2O
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Ru-Cp bond cleavage (inert, 1.4–1.9 eV) vs surface O-assisted ligand oxidation (0.4 eV)
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: 0% in open-pan TGA; metallic Ru or RuO2 film on heated substrate

references.citation: Matsui et al., Electrochem. Solid-State Lett. 2001, 4, C9 (Growth & decomposition kinetics of Ru(EtCp)2)
RSC Adv. 2014, 4, 24486 (Ruthenium CVD precursors & pyrolysis kinetics)

PREC_MET_04.name: Co(AMD)2
PREC_MET_04.t_dec_metric: TGA/DSC & thermal ALD upper window limit

measurement_conditions.technique: TGA, DSC & thermal ALD growth-rate vs temperature profiling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/Ar or vacuum sublimation (clean single-step TGA <200 °C)
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Open TGA pan; heated Si/metal substrate
measurement_conditions.phase_regime: Sublimation (<200 °C) transitioning to chelate ligand thermolysis (>215–235 °C)

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Co-N bond cleavage in bidentate N,N'-diisopropylacetamidinate chelate rings followed by isopropyl beta-H elimination / carbodiimide extrusion
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Chelate ring opening (Co-N scission) and isopropyl C-N / beta-H cleavage
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: Metallic Co (with H2) or C/N-contaminated Co above 235 °C

references.citation: Lim, Rahtu, Park, Gordon, Inorg. Chem. 2003, 42, 7951 (Transition metal amidinates TGA/stability)
Li, Lee, Coulter, Rodriguez, Gordon, Dalton Trans. 2008, 2592 (Volatile cobalt amidinates)

PREC_MET_05.name: CCTBA
PREC_MET_05.t_dec_display: 100–125 °C (rapid CVD decomposition > 125 °C; sealed-pan DSC exotherm < 150 °C; ALD window 50–80 °C)
PREC_MET_05.t_dec_metric: Sealed-pan DSC exothermic onset & ALD-to-CVD transition

measurement_conditions.technique: Sealed-pan DSC, TGA & MOCVD/ALD growth-rate profiling
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/Ar (DSC/TGA); low-pressure H2/Ar CVD/ALD reactor
measurement_conditions.container_surface: Sealed DSC pan (isolates exotherm from evaporation); heated Si/Cu wafer
measurement_conditions.phase_regime: Low-temperature labile CO dissociation + alkyne cracking

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Stepwise thermal loss of labile CO ligands from the Co2(CO)6 core followed by tert-butylacetylene dissociation or surface cracking
molecular_mechanism.reaction_equation: Co2(CO)6(tBuC#CH) -> [Co2(CO)6-x(tBuC#CH)] + x CO -> 2 Co(s) + 6 CO + tBuC#CH / C-fragments
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Initial Co-CO bond dissociation (very low thermal threshold ~100–125 °C)
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: Co metal with high C/O impurities above 125 °C due to alkyne/CO cracking

references.citation: Lee et al., Jpn. J. Appl. Phys. 2008, 47, 5396 (MOCVD Co films using CCTBA)

PREC_MET_06.name: TBTDET
PREC_MET_06.t_dec_metric: ALD upper thermal onset & DFT/Eyring kinetic barrier analysis

measurement_conditions.technique: TGA (bp 95 °C at 0.5 mmHg), ALD window profiling & DFT/Eyring kinetics
measurement_conditions.atmosphere_pressure: Inert N2/Ar or vacuum (13.3 Pa at 90 °C); NH3 co-reactant catalyzes elimination
measurement_conditions.container_surface: TGA pan; heated Si / TaN substrate

activation_energy.method: DFT / Eyring transition-state calculation (Somani et al.)

molecular_mechanism.primary_pathway: Competing beta-H elimination from -NEt2 ligands (releasing ethene/imine) and gamma-H elimination from =NtBu releasing isobutene
molecular_mechanism.rate_determining_step: Concerted isobutene or ethene elimination (barrier lowered from 76 to 64 kcal/mol by NH3/amine catalysis)
molecular_mechanism.solid_residue: TaN / TaCN thin film

references.citation: Somani et al., J. Phys. Chem. C 2011, 115 (DFT & Eyring kinetics of TBTDET decomposition)
